title: GUDECA National Executive Committee
contactPolicy: The source record carries a personal mobile number against each officer. None is published here. Contact details belong to the people they identify, and each officer would have to agree before a number went online.
currencyNote: This roster is carried in the archive without a date. Only the presidency is corroborated by a later document: the minutes of the GUDECA Europe meeting of 28 March 2026 record Mr. Thadeus Fon as General President. The remaining offices are published as recorded, not as a statement of who holds them today.
nameNote: The archive spells the President "Thadeaus"; the 2026 Bonn minutes give "Thadeus Fon" and the legacy Sons and Daughters listing gives "Thaddeus Fon". The Bonn form is used here and the variants recorded.

europe.title: GUDECA Europe
europe.note: Confirmed by the minutes of the meeting of 28 March 2026, which are signed by the Secretary General and the President.

sourceNote: Recovered 2026-09-02 from the migrated village website record src/data/pages/gudeca-exco2.json, which had never been routed. The placeholder roster formerly shown on this page came from a second migrated file that contains Joomla sample data — four fictitious names that are not Guneku people. That file is not published.
